title: Polity
description: Reference schema for docs/timeline/SPEC.md §7.1's Polity node type — a political unit that may patron traditions/deities via `patronage_edges` ('patronage' edges). Entities aggregate claims; they assert nothing on their own — every substantive statement about a Polity lives in a linked Claim (subject_type: Polity, subject_id: this entity's id), not inline here. The hand-rolled validator (docs/timeline/scripts/validate-timeline.mjs) is authoritative if this file and the validator diverge.

name.description: Common name, e.g. 'Kingdom of Kongo', 'Great Zimbabwe', 'Ashanti Empire'.

latest.description: null for polities understood to persist to the present.

patronage_edges.description: SPEC.md §7.1: 'may patron traditions/deities (patronage edges)'. Each edge needs a backing Claim.

claim_id.description: The Claim that sources this patronage relationship.
